responsibility: Implements GCC’s in-memory CTF container manager for a translation unit. This file owns creation and teardown of the container, initialization of its primary and auxiliary string tables, global access to the current TU container, hash-table insertion and lookup for CTF type and variable definitions keyed by DWARF DIEs, bookkeeping queries for counts and variable-length payload sizes, de-duplication support used by DWARF-to-CTF conversion, and helper accessors for source-location metadata and string tables that later CTF and BTF emitters consume.
same_name_distinction: Implements the CTF container API declared in ctfc.h: it owns the translation-unit global container instance, container/string-table initialization and teardown, hash-table insertion/lookup for DIE-keyed type and variable entries, and the executable logic behind the header’s CTF/BTF shared data structures.
